lang.title: Choose your language
lang.subtitle: You can change it any time from the menu.
lang.reviewNote: Translations are being checked by native speakers. Tell us if a word looks wrong.
home.title: Every district has a masterpiece. Meet its makers.
home.lead: Buy authentic crafts directly from the artisans, businesses and traders of India's districts, in your own language.
home.comingSoon: Shopping opens soon. Join now to be among the first makers and buyers.
home.odopTitle: Aligned with One District One Product
home.odopBody: One District One Product gives every district of India a signature product. Sangam connects those makers directly with buyers across India and around the world.
home.founderBody: Vrinda is a 16-year-old artist and painter from Saharanpur and the founder of ARUNARYA. She named it after her grandfather Arun, a name that means dawn.
roles.buyerDesc: Find authentic products from every district.
roles.artisanDesc: Sell your craft directly, at a fair price.
roles.business_ownerDesc: Grow your craft business beyond your district.
roles.traderDesc: Source district products for your markets.
footer.disclaimer: ARUNARYA Sangam is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any government body.

captcha.label: Security check
captcha.help: This quick check confirms you are a person, not a robot.
captcha.error: The security check could not load. Check your connection and try again.
auth.signIn.title: Log in to Sangam
auth.signIn.slowDown: For your safety, please wait {seconds} seconds before trying again.
auth.signUp.title: Create your Sangam account
auth.signUp.consent: I agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
auth.checkEmail.title: Check your email
auth.checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it on this device to activate your account. It may take a minute, and may land in your spam folder.
auth.checkEmail.resent: A new link is on its way.
auth.checkEmail.restart: Used the wrong email? Start again
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.lead: Enter the email you signed up with. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and spam folder.
auth.reset.title: Choose a new password
auth.reset.expired: This reset link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
auth.callback.confirmed: Your email is confirmed. Welcome to Sangam!
auth.callback.otherDevice: Your email is confirmed. Please log in on this device to continue.
auth.callback.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.
err.invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
err.email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox, or ask for a new link.
err.user_already_exists: This email is already registered. Log in instead, or reset your password.
err.weak_password: This password is too weak. Please choose a stronger one.
err.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
err.email_rate_limit: Too many emails have been sent. Please wait a few minutes before trying again.
err.captcha_failed: The security check failed. Please complete it again.
err.network: No internet connection. Check your network and try again.
err.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
err.same_password: Your new password must be different from your old one.
err.signup_disabled: New sign-ups are paused right now. Please try again later.
err.session_expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
err.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
